R0034.title: Automated Account Seasoning
R0034.definition: Using automated means to improve account credibility.
R0034.description: Using automated activities on stolen accounts or bulk-registered accounts to reduce account risk scores or improve account credibility — for example, automated reviews, comments, posts, and transactions.
R0034.influence: Automated account seasoning typically needs to be combined with other business risk scenarios to monetize, such as benefit abuse, flash sale grabbing, and metric manipulation.

references.title: OWASP Automated Threat: OAT-019 Account Creation

observables: Newly registered accounts perform review/posting/trading actions on a fixed cadence during the seasoning phase, with mechanical timing
Account behavior profiles are narrow (only a few action types), lacking the diverse browsing of real users
A batch of accounts performs the same seasoning action type within the same window, showing group-control traits
